review:
Big Bass Bonanza Megaways puts the fishing formula on Megaways reels, so the number of ways to win changes on every spin. The bonus is where it pays: three, four, five or six scatters award 10, 15, 20 or 25 free spins.

During free spins, fisherman symbols collect the values of all money symbols that land with them, worth up to 4,000x each. Every fourth fisherman adds 10 more spins and a win multiplier of 2x, then 3x, then 10x. Pragmatic lists a 96.70% RTP. It suits Big Bass fans who want more ways and bigger fish values.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
